answer: Operator Liability Ledger: each agent identity must be backed by an accountable operating entity that posts a quartz-signed compliance record and renews it on a fixed cadence. Renewal requires proving control of a distinct hardware relic per identity, so cloning wallets yields no valid renewal. On any sybil finding, the operator’s entire renewal history is slashed and its ability to sponsor new identities is frozen across the river of shared infrastructure. Attacker cost: one physical relic plus forfeited operator standing per fake identity.
